officialContract.runtime: @lynx-js/web-core/client registers <lynx-view>; its url property must point at a Web-encoded template.
officialContract.encoder: @lynx-js/react-rsbuild-plugin 0.16.3 selects WebEncodePlugin when the Rspeedy environment is named web or web-*.
officialContract.nativeEncoder: The lynx environment retains LynxEncodePlugin and produces main.lynx.bundle for Lynxtron.

build.webSpecificAdapter: The browser build omits the Native QuickJS banner and resolves url-search-params-polyfill to false because the browser supplies URLSearchParams.
knownWarnings: Rspack reports the existing Effect ConfigProvider direct import.meta warning twice; this is unchanged from the Native product build and does not affect output.
Rspack reports the 1.962 MiB Web template against its generic asset-size recommendation; BW3 measures iteration cost before any size decision.

controlAttempt.conclusion: Native and Web template encodings are distinct outputs and must not be copied interchangeably.

proved: The current pinned stack can emit and load a Web template from the existing production entry.
The ordinary shared surface modules and .lynx leaves both render through Lynx for Web.
The host captures bundle identity, semantic render readiness, browser dimensions, screenshot, and console.
notProved: Typed populated connector state or command handling
